responsibilities.name: Weekly Status Compilation
responsibilities.instruction: Compile a weekly status report across all active projects. For each project, gather progress on milestones, completed work, blockers, and upcoming priorities. Produce a consolidated status report following the standard status report template and save it to the project's Drive folder.

context.purpose: Provide the operator with a comprehensive weekly view of all active projects so they can make informed decisions, spot risks early, and communicate progress to stakeholders.
process: STEP 1 — Read MEMORY.md to identify all active projects and their current state.
STEP 2 — For each active project, check the project's tracking Sheet (if linked) for milestone status and action item progress.
STEP 3 — Check for any completed milestones or newly-blocked items since last report.
STEP 4 — Compile a consolidated status report using the standard template: highlights, milestones table, blockers with owners and target dates, action items, and next-week focus.
STEP 5 — Save the report to Drive using the naming convention: [Project] — Status Report — [YYYY-MM-DD].
STEP 6 — Update MEMORY.md with the report date and any new insights discovered during compilation.
context.success_criteria: A complete status report exists for each active project covering highlights, milestone status, blockers with owners, and next-week priorities. Report is saved to Drive and MEMORY.md is updated.
context.prior_learnings: Check for stale project entries in MEMORY.md — if a project has had no activity for 2+ weeks, flag it as potentially inactive rather than reporting empty status. Always verify milestone dates against the tracking Sheet rather than relying on memory alone.

responsibilities.name: Weekly Blocker Scan
responsibilities.instruction: Scan all active projects for overdue action items and unresolved blockers. Identify items that have been blocked for more than 3 days or action items past their due date. Produce a blocker summary and escalation recommendations.

context.purpose: Ensure blockers don't silently stall projects over the weekend. A Friday scan gives the operator a clear picture of what needs attention and allows them to take action before the next work week.
process: STEP 1 — Read MEMORY.md to identify all active projects and known blockers.
STEP 2 — For each project, check the action item tracker (Sheet or Doc) for items past their due date.
STEP 3 — Check for blockers that have been unresolved for more than 3 days.
STEP 4 — For each overdue or stale-blocked item, note the owner, how many days overdue, and the downstream impact.
STEP 5 — Produce a blocker summary using the blocker escalation template: issue, owner, impact, suggested resolution.
STEP 6 — If critical blockers exist (blocking milestone completion), flag them for immediate operator attention.
context.success_criteria: All overdue action items and unresolved blockers are identified and reported with owner, days overdue, and impact. Critical blockers are escalated. No stale blockers go unnoticed.
context.prior_learnings: Some action items may have informal extensions agreed upon in chat — check recent mission history before flagging. Group blockers by project to make the report scannable. Distinguish between 'waiting on external party' and 'internally stalled' blockers.

responsibilities.name: Daily Overdue Action Check
responsibilities.instruction: Check all active project action item trackers for items that are overdue or due today. Flag overdue items and produce a brief daily digest of action item status.

context.purpose: Catch overdue action items quickly rather than letting them accumulate until the weekly review. Daily visibility keeps projects moving and ensures owners are reminded promptly.
process: STEP 1 — Read MEMORY.md to identify active projects with action item trackers.
STEP 2 — For each project, check the action item tracker for items due today or overdue.
STEP 3 — Categorize items: 🔴 Overdue (past due date), 🟡 Due Today, 🟢 On Track (due within next 3 days).
STEP 4 — Produce a brief daily digest listing overdue and due-today items with owners.
STEP 5 — If any item is more than 2 days overdue, include it in a highlighted alert section.
STEP 6 — Update MEMORY.md if any items have changed status or new information was discovered.
context.success_criteria: All overdue and due-today action items are identified and reported with owner and days overdue. The digest is concise (scannable in under 30 seconds). MEMORY.md reflects current state.
context.prior_learnings: Keep the daily digest short — operators skim it quickly. Only include items that need attention (overdue or due today), not the full backlog. If no items are overdue, a brief 'all clear' message is sufficient rather than generating a full report.
